method: Whole-file manual reading of six GitHub funding/template/script/workflow files; pinned bytes verified. No workflow execution or external writes.
findings: Release-body generator validates X.Y.Z, checks gh exit codes, lists uploaded public assets and excludes debug symbols. It preserves notes around a managed section, checks marker counts and normalizes line endings for equality. Marker count equality alone does not check start-before-end ordering.

Release edit re-reads original body before overwriting and verifies resulting body afterwards. This is optimistic conflict detection with a read/write race window, not atomic compare-and-swap. Asset list is not revalidated at edit time.

Changelog uses release-tag path when possible but falls back to mutable master if only local master has the anchor. Therefore every generated changelog link is not immutable despite the script description.
WinGet helper skips submission if any matching historical PR title is returned, including closed PRs. Search is capped at100 and not an authoritative registry lookup.

WinGet validates at least one MSI, exactly one installer manifest, matching identifier/version and inclusion of MSI URLs. It removes only en-US InstallerLocale lines, rejects unexpected locales, and delegates schema/hash/installer generation to Komac. This does not establish installed upgrade behavior.
Komac is pinned2.16.0 and binstall action is commit-pinned; checkout uses mutable v4 tag and hosted runner uses windows-latest. No fully reproducible runner/toolchain guarantee.

Stable workflow downloads release MSI assets, checks presence and generated nuspec version, removes old package files before packing. Actual MSI execution and duplicate-engine tests are absent from these publish workflows.
Funding links and release-body links were read only. Scripts can submit PRs, sync forks, update release text and push packages, but none of those actions were executed.
limits: No workflows, package installation, remote release validation, manifest runtime tests, publication or external messages performed.
No foreign production code adopted; native pHash investigation remains deferred. Global completed repository count remains147/500.
